The test fails because `app.calc.mean` divides by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`. It returns `6.0` for `[2, 4, 6]`, but the test correctly expects `4`.

`CONTRIBUTING.md` prohibits editing the vendored `app/` directory, so I left the code and test unchanged. To fix this, either update the vendored code from upstream or authorize the one-line change in `app/calc.py`.
